Question: Describe your SDKs (Python minimum; TypeScript desirable) with programmatic access to all platform capabilities. Which agent frameworks are supported (LangChain, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, ADK, MAF)?
Response: GHCP SDK provides pro-code SDKs in Python and TypeScript with full programmatic access to all platform capabilities: agentic loop creation, skill loading, MCP tool integration, session hooks, OTEL instrumentation, and model selection from the Foundry catalog. GHCP SDK is open-source (MIT licence). Developer experience: define agent behaviour via SKILL.md files (declarative capabilities), implement custom logic in Python/TypeScript, build MCP servers for enterprise integrations, configure session hooks for governance. Local development and debugging supported. CLI tooling for testing and deployment. Framework interoperability: GHCP SDK is the primary framework. Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and other frameworks can be used alongside for specific tasks via MCP tool integration — any framework that can expose MCP tools or consume them can participate in the architecture. The Foundry model catalog provides access to 1900+ models usable from any SDK.
Key Technologies: GHCP SDK (Python + TypeScript), Foundry model catalog, MCP protocol, Azure API Center
POC Demo: POC1: Walk through building a custom MCP server in Python, defining a skill, configuring hooks, and deploying to Foundry.

Question: Describe your visual workflow builder for defining agent orchestrations, tool bindings, and HITL touchpoints. Is it suitable for citizen developers?
Response: Three low-code surfaces. (1) Copilot Studio: visual drag-and-drop workflow designer for AGENTS — conditional branching, tool bindings (Power Platform connectors + MCP), and HITL touchpoints. Suitable for citizen developers building conversational agents and simpler workflows. Copilot Studio agents are supported via Agent 365 — they register in the enterprise agent catalog, receive Entra Agent ID, and are governed by Purview and Defender. Our Custom Control Plane UI natively supports Copilot Studio agents alongside GHCP SDK agents. (2) Azure Logic Apps: visual workflow designer for MCP TOOLS — citizen developers chain together prebuilt connectors (1,400+ to systems like SharePoint, Outlook, Dataverse, SAP, ServiceNow) and the Logic App is exposed as an MCP tool via APIM's REST→MCP gateway. This is the no-code path for adding new tools to the agent ecosystem without writing Python. Governed identically to hand-written MCP servers (auth, rate limits, content safety, audit). (3) Custom Control Plane UI: provides a configuration-driven low-code experience for operational management — skill library management (browse, fork, customise templates backed by Azure API Center), tool catalog configuration, governance rule editing, autonomy threshold dials, and workflow template creation. No code required for operational configuration. Note: Copilot Studio runs a different runtime from GHCP SDK — it is optimised for conversational agents, not complex autonomous multi-step workflows. For WPP's most demanding workflows (hiring lifecycle, procure-to-pay), we recommend GHCP SDK pro-code. Logic Apps + Copilot Studio + Control Plane UI cover the full citizen-developer spectrum for tools, agents, and configuration respectively.
Key Technologies: Copilot Studio (low-code agents), Azure Logic Apps (low-code MCP tools via APIM REST→MCP), Agent 365 (governance), Azure API Center (skill registry), Custom Control Plane UI (configuration)
POC Demo: POC1: Demonstrate all three: GHCP SDK pro-code workflow for invoice processing; Copilot Studio agent for a simpler approval notification flow; Logic Apps workflow exposed as MCP tool for SharePoint document filing — all visible in Control Plane and governed by APIM.

Question: Can the platform agent construct new agents from natural language specifications? Describe the human-confirms, agent-builds-and-tests workflow.
Response: Yes. An agentic loop can generate new SKILL.md files from natural language specifications. Workflow: (1) Human describes the desired capability in natural language (e.g. 'I need an agent that checks invoice amounts against historical averages and flags outliers'). (2) The agentic builder loop generates a SKILL.md file with capability declaration, allowed tools, model selection, and governance rules. (3) The generated skill is submitted for human review via the Control Plane. (4) After approval, the skill is registered in Azure API Center at Design stage. (5) Automated tests run (Foundry Evaluators). (6) Human confirms promotion to Preview, then Production. This is the natural language path to agent creation — but all governance gates apply. No skill reaches production without human review and approval.
Key Technologies: GHCP SDK (agentic builder), SKILL.md generation, Azure API Center lifecycle, Foundry Evaluators
POC Demo: POC2: Demonstrate natural language agent creation — describe a capability, agentic loop generates skill, human reviews and approves in API Center.

Question: What pre-built agent templates, workflow patterns, and industry accelerators are available? Are templates forkable and customisable?
Response: Pre-built skill sets and workflow templates are maintained in Git repositories, synced to Azure API Center. For POC: (1) Talent Acquisition template — pre-built skills for screening, sourcing, scheduling, compliance, offer, onboarding. Forkable and customisable per WPP agency. (2) Procure-to-Pay template — pre-built skills for intake, validation, routing, approval, payment, reconciliation. (3) Workflow orchestration templates — Durable Functions patterns for common topologies (sequential, parallel fan-out, HITL gates, timer escalation). Templates are forkable: copy to a new repository, customise skills for the specific agency/market/use case, deploy through the standard lifecycle. API Center tracks template lineage — which templates were forked from which base. The Custom Control Plane UI provides a template browser for discovering and forking available templates.
Key Technologies: Git template repositories, Azure API Center (template registry), Custom Control Plane UI (template browser)
POC Demo: POC2: Show forking the Talent Acquisition template for a specific WPP agency — customise screening criteria, compliance rules, and deploy.
